notes: The second black strip below the bottom bar is gone. On some iPhones the app was only given part of the screen to draw in — everything stopped short of the bottom edge and the leftover strip painted black, so it looked like a whole extra bar under the navigation. Reelio now measures the phone's full screen and stretches to it: the video runs all the way down to the bottom edge, the bottom bar sits at the very bottom of the screen, and the home indicator floats over the video instead of sitting on a black band.
